workItems.title: Authenticated Dashboard Shell
workItems.description: Build the dashboard module as the post-registration and post-login destination. Scope includes protected dashboard routing, Home as the default page with a welcome message, a logged-in layout with collapsible left menu, menu entries for Home, Feedback Request, and Configure, a future-ready Configure placeholder, user name shown at the top right, logout that invalidates the session and returns to the landing page, and an icon-only dark/light theme toggle. Dependencies: registration/authentication must provide a valid session and user display name; Feedback Request content may be linked as a route placeholder until that module is delivered. Acceptance: authenticated users land on Home after login/registration, unauthenticated users cannot access the dashboard, the left menu expands/collapses without hiding primary content, top-right identity/logout/theme controls are available, logout clears the session, and browser verification remains pending per task restriction.
